meta.name: four mice, open field with blocks
meta.description: Synthetic 3D skeletons of four mice for 60 s in an 80 cm open field with three blocks they climb. Huddling, nose-to-nose, flank and anogenital sniffing, fighting, chasing over a block, crawl-over, side-by-side walking, sniffing across the tall block, approach-avoid, allogrooming and a three-mouse train, plus climbing, rearing, grooming and stretched attend. Noisy, with outliers, left/right swaps and missing (null) samples.

script.what: huddling: all four resting side by side
climbs the platform, rears on top, climbs down
rears against the tall block's wall
crosses the step bar
rears in the open
climbs the tall block, scans from the top, climbs down
approach: mouse 1 approaches mouse 2 in stretched attend
nose-to-nose
flank sniffing: mouse 1 circles mouse 2
following with anogenital sniffing
crawl-over: mouse 3 walks over resting mouse 4's back
side by side: mice 3 and 4 walk together along the north and west walls
fighting: fast circling with two boxing bouts (both rear, facing)
self-grooming
chasing: mouse 2 flees over the platform, mouse 1 chases over it too
self-grooming beside the step bar
climbs the tall block
sniffing across the tall block: mouse 1 peers down from the top, mouse 3 rears up
crosses the step bar
climbs down the tall block
approach-avoid: mouse 3 approaches mouse 2 in stretched attend, mouse 2 bolts
allogrooming: mouse 1 grooms mouse 4's neck
walks along the step bar to join the train
climbs the platform and rears on top
train: mouse 2 leads, mice 3 and 1 follow nose-to-tail, over the step bar
huddling: all four gather and settle back together
